item.title: POLITICO Europe: Costa gives Macron early Christmas present on EU budget
item.description: Governments have criticized European Council President António Costa's proposal on the bloc's 7-year budget for leaning toward France.

item.title: POLITICO Europe: How Big Oil and the Trump administration outwitted Brussels to delay an EU climate law
item.description: Intense lobbying prompted the EU to delay plans to force fossil fuel companies to report their methane emissions.

item.title: POLITICO Europe: Lucy Powell promotes UK education in China despite risks
item.description: The U.K. education secretary's visit to Beijing comes days after Wes Streeting praised the government for stepping up its interaction with China.

item.title: Euronews: Morocco: A surreal sculpture park turns the world upside down
item.description: An upside-down house, giant furniture and vegetable-headed figures await visitors at Ramakech, an 11-hectare sculpture park near Marrakech, where French artist Jean-François Fourtou brings childhood memories to life through extraordinary, larger-than-life installations.

item.title: Euronews: Midterms: US Democrats secure biggest House majority in decades
item.description: Democrats have secured their largest US House of Representatives majority in more than three decades, dealing a crushing blow to President Donald Trump and setting the stage for two years of divided government, political confrontation and ambitious legislative battles.

item.title: Euronews: Finland confirms Russia is towing drone-hit cargo ship after Baltic Sea attack
item.description: Russian authorities begin towing a damaged military-linked cargo vessel after a suspected Ukrainian drone attack near Finnish waters, highlighting growing security risks in the Baltic Sea.

item.title: Euronews: Germany tests Kamikaze drones and AI targeting technology in Lithuania
item.description: The Bundeswehr's latest military trials highlight Germany's growing investment in unmanned weapons, artificial intelligence and preparations to defend NATO's eastern flank.

item.title: Euronews: Marc Márquez wins eighth MotoGP title in Portugal, surpassing Rossi's record
item.description: The Spanish rider is crowned top-category champion in Portugal after a historic comeback in an injury-hit season. He now has ten world titles, eight in the top class.

item.title: Euronews: French interior ministry rocked by probe into prefect's leaks to National Rally
item.description: Suspected of informing the RN about probes into the party, the top official asked to be relieved of his post. He condemns a "manhunt", while Marine Le Pen says she has "never received confidential information" from him.

item.title: Euronews: Polls put Spain's PP ahead of PSOE a week before 29 November election
item.description: Polls by Ipsos, Data10, GAD3 and Hamalgama Métrica all place the PP as the leading force, though they differ on the gap to the socialists and far-right Vox’s result. All four surveys suggest a right-wing coalition would secure a majority.

item.title: Euronews: Turkey prosecutors seek asset freezes on 108 high-profit traders
item.description: Turkish prosecutors have sought asset freezes on 108 high-profit traders amid a $17 billion investment fund scandal involving alleged market manipulation and political connections.

item.title: Euronews: Tanker incident “involving military forces” reported in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Amid conflicting reports that an Iranian tanker departed Iran’s Kharg Island to Sunday to force the US military blockade in the Strait of Hormuz, an incident was reported near the US navy blockade line. Iran threatened that any US attempt to stop its tankers would result in immediate attacks.

item.title: POLITICO Europe: Global climate talks have collapsed. Here’s what just happened.
item.description: Two weeks of talks about protecting the planet from global warming ended without a deal.

item.title: Euronews: Israel forecast to grow 4.5% amid war: What can Europe learn from its tech boom?
item.description: Israel's tech-powered economy is set to overtake Sweden and Ireland to become the world's 25th-largest in 2026, the IMF says, amid years of war. As European and Israeli policymakers gather in Jerusalem this week to discuss closer ties, what can Europe learn from its innovation model?

item.title: Euronews: Suspected drone strike hits Russian ship at Libya’s Benghazi port, raising regional security concerns
item.description: A suspected drone strike on a Russian ship at Libya’s Benghazi port has raised concerns over the spread of the Russia-Ukraine conflict. Authorities are investigating the blast amid growing fears for regional security.

item.title: Euronews: Latest news bulletin | November 22nd, 2026 – Evening
item.description: Catch up with the most important stories from around Europe and beyond this November 22nd, 2026 - latest news, breaking news, World, Business, Entertainment, Politics, Culture, Travel.

item.title: POLITICO Europe: Global left rallies in Paris to make ‘not so radical’ case for taxing billionaires
item.description: Politicians from Europe and the U.S. gathered at Gabriel Zucman's summit to challenge the power of the super-rich — but few are in a position to act.

item.title: POLITICO Europe: Cyprus expels Russian diplomats on suspicion of espionage
item.description: The two men were suspected of working for Russian intelligence services under diplomatic cover.

item.title: Euronews: West Bank: Four Palestinian villages targeted in suspected settler attacks
item.description: Burnt-out cars, damaged trucks and anti-Arab graffiti were discovered in four Palestinian villages in the Israeli-occupied West Bank on Sunday 22 November 2026, following overnight attacks blamed by local activists on Israeli settlers.

item.title: Euronews: Autopsy report reveals: Baltic Sea whale 'Timmy' starved to death
item.description: A tragic end to a media spectacle: New findings into the death of humpback whale 'Timmy' reveal that the animal had gone a prolonged time without food.

item.title: Euronews: BepiColombo space probe enters Mercury's orbit after eight-year journey
item.description: The mission aims to study all aspects of Mercury in the hopes of providing scientists with a better understanding of the planet and of the evolution of our solar system.

item.title: Euronews: COP31 climate talks fail after EU and others reject final deal proposal
item.description: A new COP31 draft agreement had been published early on Sunday amid a row over fossil fuels, which have been a flashpoint at the talks.

item.title: POLITICO Europe: COP31 : l’accord capote sur fond de désaccord sur les énergies fossiles
item.description: Les négociations n’ont pas réussi à aboutir sur un accord malgré les avertissements concernant un réchauffement climatique galopant.

item.title: POLITICO Europe: Climate deal collapses amid fossil fuel rows
item.description: Climate leaders failed to strike a deal despite warnings over runaway global warming.

item.title: Euronews: Emergency workers recover at least six body bags after Indonesian factory fire
item.description: Video footage posted on social media by Indonesia's National Search and Rescue Agency (Basarnas), showed emergency crews looking through the charred remains of the building.

item.title: POLITICO Europe: ‘Brexit is done’: Theresa May tells Burnham to move on
item.description: The former British prime minister spent three years trying to negotiate a Brexit deal with the EU.

item.title: Euronews: 14 people missing after Russian drone strike on Kyiv region
item.description: Timur Tkachenko, the head of the Kyiv Regional Military Administration, said the body of one person had been recovered from the rubble and that three people had been injured.
